data.summary: Reviews show strong signals of authenticity in both praise and criticism. The negative review is highly detailed and credible, describing a specific pattern of billing for unperformed service. Positive reviews are also detailed and varied. The lower Angi score and complaint pattern suggest real operational issues with reliability, not fake reviews. The limited total number of reviews is a minor concern but not a strong fake signal.
fake_signals: Limited total review volume (18 on Google, 9 on Angi) makes patterns harder to assess
Incomplete Yelp data prevents full cross-platform analysis
authentic_signals: Specific details in positive reviews (employee names like Bryan and Jon, specific repairs like control panels)
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
Negative review provides specific, credible allegations with mention of evidence (pictures, receipts)
complaint_patterns: Defensive or dismissive response to complaints
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google rating (4.3) is significantly higher than Angi rating (3.6). Yelp data is incomplete, showing only a 5.0 rating from 1 review in snippets, but no full profile or review count is accessible.

reviews.text: We moved to Texas Clear Pools after a bad experience with a previous service, and never looked back. We’ve been with them for about two years now, and they’re always communicative, they show up every week, they let you know when there is a potential problem and offer multiple options for resolution in order to help my budget. Bryan spent a lot of time helping me understand the system today while he diagnosed a filter issue. We really appreciate the friendly and professional service.
reviews.author: Theresa Jackson

reviews.text: We had a pool that needed dire repairs on its control panel as everything shut down. We were worried about a $5k bill which we couldn't handle but then we met with Jon and his business here and they gave a super affordable quote at about half of what we expected which was very fair and installed it only a few days later after order.  I have immense trust in these guys and really want folks to understand that these guys represent good business A+. Its good priced, good owners/managers, super professional, Always gonna hire.
reviews.author: Thomas Wilke

reviews.text: This company is awesome! Been using them for years and they always go above and beyond keeping my pool clean and running smoothly - at a great price. 10/10 highly recommend.
reviews.author: Lena Mehl

reviews.text: After trouble finding a quality pool service company I was lucky enough to find Texas Clear Pools several years ago.  Everyone with the company goes above and beyond, are courteous, and hard working.  Excellent service at a great price.  Thanks for the help you’ve given with my pool.
reviews.author: Cory Jensen

reviews.text: While they do a good job of cleaning the pool and maintenance when they show up.  They are not a reliable or reputable company in my opinion.   Too many times, I have been sent a message that my pool was serviced when in fact it was not.   The person never even showed up at my property.   They try to make excuses for the worker and not respecting the word of the customer.   I take care of my cleaners with TIPS above the cost of cleaning.  They'll make up excuses that you are not seeing what you are seeing unless you have proof, even then, they will still make excuses.  It's not cool to bill for 4 weeks but only show up for 3.  I have receipts with stories and pictures, but I won't go into much more detail.   Unless I need to!
reviews.author: Greg Morris

reviews.text: Texas Clear Pools has been servicing my pool and equipment for years.  They are on-time, do a great job and are reasonable.  Their equipment repairs and replacement is prompt and knowledgeable.  A good company to work with.
reviews.author: Jim Somach

reviews.text: We are very happy with the pool service and maintenance that Texas Clear Pools provides. Jon is a great communicator, and seems to always be able to help when needed. We really appreciated his dedication to his customers after the crazy ice-mageddon of 2021! His staff is always courteous.
reviews.author: Stacy Patrick

reviews.text: We have used Texas Clear since moving to Texas. Our pool is older and we knew we needed a team that would treat it like the pool was their own. Success. Texas Clear has maintained perfect water balance as well as ensured proper working order of our equipment. As long as we own a pool Texas Clear will be our team.
reviews.author: Kenneth LaPlante
